integrity: Direct proof and standalone exhaustive checks for q=2,3,4; generality relies on symbolic arguments. Mathematical independence was not assessed.
scientific_limitations: The rank census applies to the particular algebra \(A=\mathbb F_q[X,Y]/(X^2,Y^2)\), not to all monomial quotients; rank is the \(\mathbb F_q\)-linear operator rank. Equivalent published finite-field enumerations outside the checked sources remain possible.
title: Derivation-rank polynomials and a nonsmooth symmetry jump in a four-dimensional monomial complete intersection
